summary: drips audit groups outbound SMS by contact and the FULL message body; the 80-character head is display only. Round 4 (Codex novel1219-r3): the command carries the runtime pp:data-source=local annotation matching its comment, so root rejects --data-source live before any store access.
reason: Greptile round 1 on PR #2450 (P1): grouping by the first 80 characters reported two different messages with a shared introduction as a double send (exit 2). drips audit has no counterpart in the public entry, so this is the reprint's command fixed in place.
validated_outcome: TestNovel1219DripsAuditGroupsByTheFullBody flags only the contact that received the same full body twice. Round 4: TestNovel1219DripsAuditRejectsDataSourceLiveBeforeTheStore.
